description: Defines a 'Note' class for a note-taking app, utilizing Hive for local data storage. Includes fields for title, body, timestamps, tags, and color, with methods to update note details.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A Hive-stored data model representing a note with various fields and an update method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the mutable fields of the Note instance and refreshes the 'updatedAt' timestamp.
